items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: we had made an agreement with Johnny ... that I was supposed to take over the band and it would still be Jay McShann and his band ... under the direction of Gene Ramey.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, Jay told me that when he was inducted off the bandstand, that night the book was stolen.
Yeah, and for a long time, Johnny thought and I think he told Jay that he thought I took the thing. I'll tell you what happened there.
First of all, when McShann first -- well, when he had to leave we played the Howard Theatre in Washington, and this was in January of '44, and we had -- the band was booked
